Backend: all 12 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_leads.py PASSED (health, POST 200 + persistence via GET, PUT/DELETE 405, validation 400, CORS preflight + POST for offers.discoverdazeholidays.com and discoverdazeholidays.com). Opening WhatsApp…' shown, no runtime overlay, WhatsApp URL captured via preWin.location.href starts with https://wa.me/917006186445?text= and contains 30%25 + encoded name/phone. (4) Error handling: routing /api/leads to abort → ERROR toast 'Submission failed: Network Error' shown, NO WhatsApp navigation and preWin.close() invoked. critical_code_review_comments: BookingForm.jsx API base logic (line 19-20) correctly branches on full-URL vs relative — verified in preview it uses absolute URL. Note: vercel.json rewrite only applies on Vercel and cannot be validated from the Emergent preview (documented and not a regression).

handleBook desktop pre-opens window.open('', '_blank') in the click gesture — good popup-blocker mitigation. On mobile, window.location.href is used correctly (isMobile() UA regex matches iPhone/Android/Mobile).

server.py CORS: allow_credentials=True with fallback wildcard '*' in CORS_ORIGINS is invalid per spec — currently benign because allow_origin_regex handles *.discoverdazeholidays.com. Recommend setting CORS_ORIGINS explicitly in prod .env.
